messages.subject: combining crosses
parts:
Is it possible to combine crosses that do not have the exact same
genetic map? (such as two crosses that used different markers)

messages.author: f388084a0de67b60

parts:
You would need to create a map that included all of the markers,
though some could be typed in one cross but not the other.
